title: Vermont Green FC repeats feat with second straight undefeated championship season
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Vermont Green FC achieved a second consecutive undefeated championship season in the USL League Two.
Coach Chris Taylor has led the team through 42 unbeaten games, with 35 wins and seven draws.
In the finals, midfielder Ryan Zellefrow scored the winning penalty against Flint City Bucks.

title: Review & setlists: Boston favorite Extreme steals Mötley Crüe’s thunder in Mansfield
author: Christopher Hurley
bullets: Extreme, a Boston-based band, opened for Mötley Crüe and delivered a standout performance at the Xfinity Center on August 1, 2026.
Extreme's set, featuring songs from their latest album 'Six', captivated the audience with an 11-song performance including hits 'Decadence Dance' and 'More Than Words'.
Tesla followed Extreme, and Mötley Crüe headlined the event with a 90-minute show filled with classic hits like 'Dr. Feelgood' and 'Kickstart My Heart'.

title: BPD searching for missing Roxbury man, 84, with dementia
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: James Clarke, 84, of Roxbury, was reported missing and last seen on Hawthorne Street at 1 p.m. Saturday.
Clarke, who has dementia, is described as a Black male, 5'11", 140 pounds, wearing a black hat and blue flannel.
Boston Police urge anyone with information on Clarke's whereabouts to contact 911 or District B-2 detectives.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial enters second week after jurors hear from more first responders
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's trial continues with testimony from nurses and doctors about her injuries and her children's conditions.
Dr. Kelly McDonough testified about Clancy's thoracic spine injury and superficial cuts after a suicide attempt.
Dr. Andrew Capraro described significant brain damage in Clancy's youngest child, leading to a decision against surgery.

title: Zac Brown gave free cruises to fans at Sunday’s Fenway concert — all of them
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Zac Brown Band gave over 35,000 fans at Fenway Park a free cruise for two as a surprise gift.
The giveaway, valued at over $40 million, marked the band's 15th consecutive sold-out show at Fenway.
Fans must redeem their Margaritaville at Sea cruise trips within a year, signed up by midnight Sunday.

title: Phish brought near-record crowds to this Fenway dispensary — but not a product shortage
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: New Dia Fenway matched its record sales during Phish's two-night concert at Fenway Park, with no inventory shortages.
The dispensary hosted Phish PhanArt, benefiting the Mockingbird Foundation, as customers traveled worldwide for the event.
New Dia Fenway plans inventory around major events, staying fully stocked despite large crowds from nearby concerts.

title: Red Sox homer 3 times over 7 pitches en route to statement sweep of Dodgers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Boston Red Sox swept the Los Angeles Dodgers with an 8-4 victory, hitting four home runs on Sunday.
The Red Sox have won 28 out of 33 games since June 25, securing the second AL Wild Card spot.
Boston hit three home runs in the third inning across seven pitches, showcasing their offensive power.

title: Rafaela homers for 3rd straight game as the Red Sox beat the Dodgers 8-4 for 3-game sweep
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit a home run in three consecutive games, helping the Red Sox sweep the Dodgers 8-4.
Jake Bennett allowed three runs over 5 2/3 innings, contributing to Boston's fifth straight win with a 23-3 record since July 3.
Jarren Duran hit Boston's fourth solo homer, while Dalton Rushing was pulled from the Dodgers' lineup due to arm irritation.

title: Stoughton police chief and town manager placed on leave amid investigation after chief alleges discrimination, harrassment
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Stoughton Police Chief Donna McNamara and Town Manager Thomas Calter are on paid leave amid discrimination and harassment probes.
McNamara filed a lawsuit alleging Calter discriminated against her as a woman and interfered with her role as police chief.
Town Manager Calter denies McNamara's allegations, stating no evidence of harassment was found by the town's IT department.

title: Here’s what meteorologists are saying about heavy rain and possible flooding Monday
author: Jack Pickell and Heather Alterisio
bullets: Flash flood warnings issued from Philadelphia to Manchester due to heavy rain and organized thunderstorms.
Interior Massachusetts, northwest Rhode Island, and Connecticut at high risk for flash flooding in poor drainage areas.
Southeastern Massachusetts expects strong wind gusts of 40-50 MPH, mainly affecting Cape Cod and the Islands.
